verdict.rationale: A training opt-out is a fair privacy question for an AI plugin ecosystem running in ChatGPT and Codex, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents a control to keep user data out of model training. The Sign in with ChatGPT note says only name, email and profile picture are shared with partners; that is about third-party data sharing, an adjacent topic, and earns no credit for this story.
